decisionEvents.ret: "What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it. That is all."
"Hey." Sam settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Ursula sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"When's the last time you really laughed? Worth considering."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday, as it were."
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday. Just... be straight with me."
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed? That's the whole of it."
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"About the sickness I'm fighting — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you take a look?"
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"Can we talk? Have you seen anyone on the roads? Anyone at all? I'm asking everyone."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Olusegun?"
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. I need help. Please."
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Can we talk?" Leonid glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them. But what do I know."
